optimized_sql:
SELECT item.i_item_id,
       SUM(s.quantity_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.quantity_count), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(s.list_price_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.list_price_count), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(s.coupon_amt_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.coupon_amt_count), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(s.sales_price_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.sales_price_count), 0) AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_item_sk,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS quantity_sum,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS quantity_count,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS list_price_sum,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS list_price_count,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_amt_sum,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_amt_count,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sales_price_sum,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sales_price_count
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk
    WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'College'
      AND (promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' OR promotion.p_channel_event = 'N')
      AND date_dim.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_item_sk
) AS s
INNER JOIN item ON s.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY item.i_item_id
ORDER BY item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
